verdict.rationale: Bento has a beginner DNS onboarding guide that has you add DNS records to authenticate your domain and let Bento send on your behalf, which covers guided custom-domain authentication at its core. That single doc excerpt does not name the specific records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) or describe how setup is verified. Missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment coverage, an in-product DNS verification/status check, independent or hands-on corroboration.
